productName.title: Product Name
productName.description: Your product or brand name (automatically excluded from competitor complaint results).

productUrl.title: Product Website URL
productUrl.description: Public homepage URL crawled to extract factual verified capabilities.

productDescription.title: Product Description & Core Advantages
productDescription.description: Describe what your product does, pricing model, and top differentiators.
productDescription.example: Flat $15/mo invoicing for freelancers and small agencies. Unlimited clients, automated overdue payment reminders, 0% markup on Stripe/Wise/UPI, 1-click FreshBooks/QuickBooks CSV import.

competitors.title: Known Competitors (Optional)
competitors.description: Leave blank to auto-discover top 4-6 competitors automatically.

sources.title: Complaint Sources
sources.description: Select platforms to harvest. Default Lean mode excludes G2 for fast ~40s runs.

lookbackDays.title: Lookback Window (Days)
lookbackDays.description: Only harvest complaints published within the last N days.

minWinabilityScore.title: Minimum Hot-Lead Score (0-100)
minWinabilityScore.description: Complaints scoring at or above this threshold receive dual outreach drafts.

tone.title: Outreach Tone
tone.description: Select the tone or style to use when generating the output.

llmApiKey.title: Optional BYOK Gemini API Key
llmApiKey.description: Optional: provide your own Google AI Studio key for high-volume commercial runs.
